session_migrations.note: agent_intents: typed intents with continuation tokens

transaction_notes: each migration runs in one transaction; all additive (new tables/columns); a pre-026 backup migrates forward on `migrate` (test_ops_search.test_prior_backup_migrates_and_serves, journey 23) and, since issue 34, `restore` of such a backup is accepted under the upgraded code and reports pending_migrations (test_service test_13)
rollback: no destructive change; an older binary must not run against a newer database (schema check refuses newer, unknown or gapped schemas); the live upgrade kept a keyed backup at schema 025 for rollback
